description: Bounded Colorado center-only acquisition and immutable offline replay; source candidates, not verified active businesses.
redirect_policy: Reject redirects and omit credentials. Fixed catalog and public SODA resource GET requests only; no method or endpoint fallback.
retry: No automatic retries; denial or publisher deferral stops the attempt without access workarounds.
checkpoint: Persist prerequisite before roster requests and each validated observation before advancing; reconcile baseline, selected rows, final roster and postflight.
idempotency: Immutable UUID acquisitions with independent offline replay. Reuse verified retained releases; partial journals are inspection evidence, not automatic restart or resume.
cancellation: Abort headers, body and pacing; drain retained writes, clean only owned incomplete cancellation artifacts, preserve uncertain publications.
retention_profile: Internal nine-field center records and sanitized metadata; exclude homes, contacts, governing-body values, quality-rating dates and coordinates.

output_schema_contract.source_key: Canonical positive integer provider_id text, max32 digits, compared numerically without floating-point conversion; source licensing identity only
output_schema_contract.optional_values: Preserve selected source strings, explicit nulls and omissions; blank strings count as nonnull for publisher aggregate reconciliation
